briefdescription.para: Frozen distributed knowledge contract: entity lifecycle, federation, retrieval, and LWW conflict resolution.

detaileddescription.para: This header defines the normative contract for the distributed_knowledge module. All components (entity stores, federation coordinators, retrieval engines, and conflict resolvers) must honour these semantics within the v1.x major line.

sect2.title: Entity Contract
sect2.para: Entity-relation pairs are immutable after commit. Readers see a consistent snapshot; updates produce a new version rather than mutating in place. Reads are eventually consistent: a read immediately after a write on a different node may return the previous version until propagation completes.

sect2.title: Federation Contract
sect2.para: A cross-node query result is the union of per-node results with duplicates removed. The federation layer must not introduce phantom entities or omit entities that exist on at least one reachable node.

sect2.title: Conflict Resolution Contract
sect2.para: When the same entity is written on two nodes concurrently, the Last-Write-Wins (LWW) strategy is applied using the entity's wall-clock timestamp. On a timestamp tie, the node with the lexicographically larger node-ID wins.

sect2.title: Retrieval Contract
sect2.para: neighbours() returns ALL direct edges from the given node within the local shard. The result set MUST be complete (no silent omissions) and MUST NOT contain duplicate edges.

sect2.title: Versioning
sect2.para: This contract is stable within v1.x. Breaking changes require a v2.0 bump.
